page_title: UNI 3-1 RBL | Union Berlin v RB Leipzig 12/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' 3 - 1 Goal! Andrej Ilic plays a simple square pass into the feet of Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 3:1.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Nicolas Seiwald did his best and is replaced by Timo Werner (RB Leipzig).
90' Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
87' The corner from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is cleared away by the defence.
85' A substitution has been made. Derrick Kohn is replaced by Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin).
85' Great touch by Andrija Maksimovic (RB Leipzig) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
85' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) replacing Ilyas Ansah.

83' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the middle of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.

82' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
81' Substitution. Andrija Maksimovic (RB Leipzig) has come on for Kosta Nedeljkovic.
79' Good clearance! Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
77' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) and Tidiam Gomis attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
74' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) launches a cross from the corner, but Peter Gulacsi is alert to thwart the effort.
73' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The linesman points to the corner flag, Union Berlin are going to take it.
72' The referee shows a yellow card to Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
70' Christoph Baumgartner is picked out by David Raum (RB Leipzig), but one of the defenders arrives to clear.
69' Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
67' Here is a change. Oliver Burke is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin).
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) will replace Woo-Yeong Jeong.
65' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off the line to clear the ball away.
63' 2 - 1 Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the right post.
63' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin), but the defence gets it clear.
62' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
62' The corner is swung in but Union Berlin can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
60' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Conrad Harder provided an assist for the goal.
59' Steffen Baumgart prepares a substitution. Janik Haberer is replaced by Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin).
58' Substitution. Johan Bakayoko leaves the pitch and is replaced by Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig).
57' 1 - 0 Goal! Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the top left corner.
55' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniel Schlager had an easy-decision to make.
53' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
52' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Union Berlin.
52' The ball is cleared after Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Union Berlin are awarded a corner kick.
50' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and David Raum (RB Leipzig) duly receives a yellow card.
47' Conrad Harder plays a pass into the path of Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig), who shoots way too fast from mid-range and sends the ball miles over the bar.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) decides to take on the shot from mid-range after a rebound, but he fails to connect properly with the ball and the effort sails harmlessly wide of the left post.

42' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
42' David Raum (RB Leipzig) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
40' Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig) plays a one-two with Christoph Baumgartner, but the move breaks down.
39' David Raum (RB Leipzig) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
37' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.
37' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
33' David Raum (RB Leipzig) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
32' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig win a corner kick.
30' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) is penalised for a foul. Daniel Schlager had a clear view and blows his whistle.

29' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
26' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well wide of the right post.
25' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) sends a long ball forward to Johan Bakayoko, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
23' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
23' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Union Berlin.
21' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) commits a foul and Daniel Schlager immediately signals a free kick.
19' David Raum (RB Leipzig) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

18' What a great chance for Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header towards the foot of the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. RB Leipzig win a corner.
17' David Raum (RB Leipzig) will take the corner.

17' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Frederik Ronnow makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the bottom right corner. The ball goes out of play. RB Leipzig are awarded a corner kick.
16' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner with a short pass.
16' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by David Raum (RB Leipzig) but poses no threat. The ball is out of play and RB Leipzig manage to earn a corner.
14' Chance! Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards goal, but Peter Gulacsi is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
13' A clumsy foul by Kosta Nedeljkovic (RB Leipzig) and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle.
13' David Raum (RB Leipzig) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
11' Good defending. Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) tries to find Conrad Harder inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
10' The corner from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is intercepted by the defence.
9' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. RB Leipzig earn a corner.
9' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
8' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
6' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
5' Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
3' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
3' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) and Xaver Schlager attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
The players are out and the match is about to start. RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniel Schlager.
